policy: The user's later instruction retains the full schematic, including AR. Archived text describing cuts/stretch priorities is historical and does not authorize dropping features. Alternative ideas (Care Card AR as a separate product, Referral Relay and Follow-up Memory) are not silently imported into Visit Bridge.
verificationScope: Baseline 9b8261a plus marker/replay source inspection, 89 automated tests, real QR codec/browser checks and final cached-shell reference lookup with the application server stopped; see docs/marker-replay.md. Physical iPhone Safari, camera tracking, airplane mode, printer, qualified language/security/clinical and comprehension evidence remain pending.

items.title: Name the worker, country/context and existing demo device
items.remaining: Spanish and iPhone with Safari are chosen. Exact phone model/iOS, country, authorized worker role and local workflow review remain pending.
items.acceptance: Document actual role, setting, device/OS/browser and language; label fictional assumptions; obtain local workflow input.

items.title: Minimal data and source/output provenance
items.remaining: Maintain the synthetic-data restriction and avoid adding unnecessary identifiers.
items.acceptance: Original, derived wording, languages, versions and approval timestamps remain separate; no identity or diagnostic dataset required.

items.title: Typed fallback and selected return-visit template
items.remaining: Complete manual administrative fields and exact return-visit template implemented. Validate usability with the chosen worker/device.
items.acceptance: A worker can type and complete the approved return-visit journey without AI; invalid calendar dates are rejected.

items.title: Short on-device voice note and editable transcript
items.remaining: Local English API is implemented; preview device cannot run recognition. Test mic, noise, dialect and code-switching on chosen device; supported-language coverage remains constrained.
items.acceptance: Live target-device recognition works offline or remains explicitly unavailable with typed fallback; no hidden cloud recognizer.

items.title: Preserve source and show draft separately
items.remaining: Keep this behavior when adding structured extraction.
items.acceptance: Original, model suggestion and worker edits remain distinguishable; model never automatically finalizes.

items.title: Fixed fields for action/date/place/item/reported concern
items.remaining: Supported administrative fields, provenance and revision approval are implemented. Validate the chosen real workflow/device; clinical transformation remains outside supported scope.
items.acceptance: Source-backed fields are editable; worker choices resolve ambiguity; reported information is separate from the worker decision; no invented values.

items.title: AI organizes variable worker notes into fixed fields
items.remaining: Per-field local extraction, source-span/schema validation and a complete manual fallback are implemented. Real smoke runs extracted a date but misclassified action/place; bounded observed conflicts are flagged. Broad fidelity and actual target-device/network validation remain outstanding. Exact quotes do not prove correct categorization.
items.acceptance: Only information present in the source can enter a draft field; worker checks each field; unsupported output is refused.

items.title: Missing, ambiguous and low-confidence details
items.remaining: Workflow-required fields and bounded date/time/item/conditional checks are implemented. Detection is incomplete for arbitrary natural language; human review and real-device evaluation remain required.
items.acceptance: Maybe Thursday remains uncertain; the model never chooses a date/place; worker can explicitly resolve or leave an optional field blank; required unresolved fields block finalization.

items.title: Unsupported clinical content and source-note authority
items.remaining: UI declares the boundary but screening is not a general clinical-content safeguard. Restrict model transformation to supported administrative handoffs and display an original-language/human-reviewed fallback for unsupported content.
items.acceptance: Model cannot introduce treatment, diagnosis, dosage, urgency or referral decisions; unsupported content receives explicit review/fallback, with residual limitations documented.

items.title: Separate worker review of original and exact patient text
items.remaining: Retain approvals and revocation rules for all new fields, exports and replay paths.
items.acceptance: Editing source/final content invalidates corresponding approval; saved/AR/audio outputs require exact approved revisions.

items.title: Correct, reject, cancel and interrupt without stale output
items.remaining: Keep cancellation consistent with future lock/understanding flows.
items.acceptance: Workers can stop/edit/reject; stale mic/model/XR events cannot apply to another visit.

items.title: One named, reviewed patient language
items.remaining: Spanish return-visit demo works; no qualified/community review is supplied. Obtain review and actual-context justification; preserve unvalidated status until evidence exists.
items.acceptance: A fluent reviewer verifies action/date/place; reviewer scope and provenance are recorded with consent; content is understandable in the named local setting.

items.title: Explicit unsupported language/phrase fallback

evidence.anchor: Spanish supports the return-visit template only

items.remaining: Extend cautiously to future templates only after reviewed language content exists.
items.acceptance: No arbitrary Spanish translation or English/remote-voice substitution; original/typed text remains available.

items.title: Dates, numbers, dialect and speech-resource evaluation
items.remaining: Evaluate exact phrases, date pronunciation, dialect, noisy speech and code-switching with consented/fluent reviewers; use licensed data only if actually used.
items.acceptance: Record sample, model/content version, language/dialect, device, errors and limits; do not cite a resource as used merely because the brief lists it.

items.title: One action per line, large text and meaningful pictograms
items.remaining: Approved line order and administrative symbols implemented. Arbitrary worker wording retains its own line breaks; no automatic sentence reinterpretation. Physical-device readability and participant symbol interpretation remain under accessibility/comprehension.
items.acceptance: All approved actions remain readable and in order; icons supplement text/audio; no color-only meaning or inferred clinical imagery.

items.title: Approved local-language playback and replay
items.remaining: English/Spanish browser speech events passed; actual speaker output and target-phone pronunciation still need review.
items.acceptance: Exact approved text is spoken only by a matching local voice; replay/stop work offline on the intended device or text fallback is clear.

items.title: Worker checks and records patient understanding
items.remaining: Worker recording and approval-version behavior implemented. Actual patient comprehension and frontline-worker review remain tracked under comprehension; no automated score or patient-answer storage.
items.acceptance: Worker can explain, ask patient to repeat the next step, mark result, reclarify and save the result; changing approved content requires a fresh understanding check.

items.title: Save/reopen/delete exact approved copies locally
items.remaining: Schema 6 adds independent purpose permissions and preserves approved understanding; schemas 1–5 migrate unchanged and reopen after unlock. Maintain encrypted transactional writes and the original approval guards.
items.acceptance: Save succeeds after transaction commit; reopening retains approval/provenance; cancellation and delete failures preserve correct state.

items.title: Encrypted local encounter storage
items.remaining: Implemented for fictional cards, with verified atomic migration, protected keys and ciphertext at rest. User must complete vault setup; until then legacy cards remain plaintext. Qualified security and target-device validation remain pending.
items.acceptance: Stored payload is authenticated ciphertext; wrong key fails safely; original records are migrated only with a documented recovery/commit path; do not claim full device compromise protection.

items.title: App lock, session timeout and explicit privacy control
items.remaining: Explicit, inactivity, background/page lifecycle and cross-tab locks clear sensitive application state and cancel media/late work. Physical-device timer/media behavior and stronger OS/device management remain unverified.
items.acceptance: A shared-device user sees no saved instructions before unlock; timeout ends active sessions; key lifetime/reset behavior is documented.

items.title: Encounter recording/save notices and consent workflow
items.remaining: Separate not-recorded/granted/declined dictation and saving controls, timestamps, admission guards and alternatives are implemented for fictional encounters. Remains partial until a real authorized context has a qualified consent procedure; code cannot establish legal or informed consent.
items.acceptance: Worker records consent/decline as required by the workflow; denial preserves typed/non-recorded alternatives; notices describe actual retention and sharing.

items.title: No ambient recording or raw audio retention
items.remaining: Continue to store no raw audio; no delete-after-review mechanism is needed when raw audio is never retained by the app.
items.acceptance: Mic requires active start; navigation/cancellation/lock stops it; no application audio blobs are persisted.

items.title: Credible shared/lost-device behavior
items.remaining: Documented unlocked/shared-device exposure, offline guessing, no recovery/backups/remote wipe, browser eviction, logical deletion and incomplete protection against compromised devices. Production security and institutional device-management validation remain pending.
items.acceptance: Describe exactly who can decrypt and read, what a lost/shared device exposes, and recovery/erasure limitations; no claim of remote revocation without a real service.

items.title: Local inference and no automatic patient upload
items.remaining: Architecture confines content to local workers; target-device network inspection of full voice/inference/translation path is still outstanding.
items.acceptance: Record network evidence showing public pack downloads only during installation, and no patient-content transmission during the tested core flow.

items.title: Offline shell/PWA and visible readiness
items.remaining: Check installation on the chosen phone and after hosting-origin changes.
items.acceptance: After cache/install, shell and saved cards reopen without the application server; readiness distinguishes shell from model/voice packs.

items.title: Complete essential workflow in airplane mode
items.remaining: Server-stopped checks are not full airplane-mode proof; new missing core features must be included in final verification.
items.acceptance: On the declared device: launch, create, AI organize where promised, approve, explain, mark understanding, encrypted save/reopen/edit/delete, replay and AR as promised without connectivity.

items.title: Named model/runtime versions, size and licenses
items.remaining: Maintain actual byte counts and clearly distinguish download size from runtime memory.
items.acceptance: Pinned model/runtime files and licenses documented; no credential or patient-data commit.

items.title: Portable model installation over constrained connections
items.remaining: Pinned public pack transfer, staged verification and local import/export implemented. Real 206,665,468-byte archive imported and ran with receiving app server stopped. Physical transfer, full disconnection, quota/low-end performance remain unverified; pack does not install shell, language content or OS voices.
items.acceptance: Previously downloaded pack can be installed on a supported device without re-fetching all assets; invalid/incomplete files are refused; no smaller-device feasibility claim without measurement.

items.title: Device feasibility, latency and memory measurements
items.remaining: Desktop inference succeeded but target-phone memory/latency, low-end limits and weak-connection installation have no measurements.
items.acceptance: Record device/browser, cold/warm latency, transfer size, memory measurement method and failure rates; no invented benchmark.

items.title: Printable/offline portable patient summary
items.remaining: Approved-only print/download software implemented and Spanish HTML verified during server outage. Actual paper/PDF output, target-device readability and local workflow validation remain pending. Exported copies cannot be recalled.
items.acceptance: Paper/portable output is readable, matches approved text, preserves Spanish status and works without AR or network; printing hardware availability is stated.

items.title: Place/resize/rotate/reposition approved card in spatial AR
items.remaining: Implemented supplementary surface AR; current preview has no immersive support, so GPU/camera/physical placement remain unverified.
items.acceptance: Actual phone finds a surface and renders approved content; denial/tracking loss/exit safely return to the regular card.

items.title: Original visual-marker scan-to-replay experience
items.remaining: Opaque printed QR, explicit local scan/lookup/confirmation and camera-marker projection are implemented and software-tested. Actual printed-marker camera tracking and iPhone Safari/airplane-mode evidence remain pending.
items.acceptance: Scanning the worker's card on a compatible device identifies the correct approved snapshot offline; unknown/stale markers fail clearly without retrieving another patient's card.

items.title: Approved visual sequence and local-language audio in AR
items.remaining: Exact approved visual steps and local-language speech are integrated with marker and surface AR; Spanish notice remains. Physical device/speaker/pronunciation and actual offline verification remain pending.
items.acceptance: Each visual step represents an approved action; exact matching local-language audio can replay/stop inside AR; unsupported voice retains text; no generated clinical imagery.

items.title: AR offline and plain-card comparison evidence
items.remaining: Fallback loads offline but physical AR and comprehension benefits have not been tested.
items.acceptance: Record supported-device offline scan/replay result and compare with plain card; distinguish engagement from measured understanding.

items.title: 10–20 synthetic scenarios and fidelity/correction evidence
items.remaining: Unit/controller checks exist, but no aggregate scripted scenario evaluation or field-extraction result set.
items.acceptance: Include absent/ambiguous dates, negatives, noisy/misheard input, code-switching, unsupported language/content; record introduced facts, corrections/rejections and sample/method.

items.title: Measured AI vs plain-form/paper baseline
items.remaining: Working typed baseline exists but no time/effort comparison substantiates AI value.
items.acceptance: Same synthetic tasks are compared fairly; report time, correction burden and successful task completion without claiming unmeasured health outcomes.

items.title: Consented/fluent/user understanding evaluation
items.remaining: No participant comprehension or local-worker workflow review results.
items.acceptance: Consented small test uses fictional scenarios; record sample/context, ability to repeat next step, limits and comparison; no participant identities/public raw recordings.

items.title: Phone/keyboard/audio inclusivity and screen-reader validation
items.remaining: Responsive layout and basic AR overflow checks exist; verify target-phone controls, screen reader, focus, pictogram comprehension and multi-action layout.
items.acceptance: Key flow completes with large controls and keyboard/screen-reader alternatives; color is not the only cue; patient need not own a smartphone.

items.title: Context sources separated from model/evaluation data
items.remaining: Research has been recovered, but no final country/year/source evidence register or clear list of datasets actually used exists. Verify cited claims before submission.
items.acceptance: Each claim has source/year/geography/limits; distinguish supporting context from tool/evaluation inputs; never imply training on listed but unused resources.

items.title: Localization/adoption/replication and institutional-fit notes
items.remaining: Add deployment adaptation requirements, local review responsibilities, existing-workflow fit and no-duplicate-paperwork evaluation.
items.acceptance: Another team can identify required language content, device, role, data policy, review process, model assets and limitations.

items.title: Optional authorized later health-system synchronization
items.remaining: Preserved as an original future capability. There is no authorized destination; do not build/send records to an invented system. Define interface and ownership boundary before implementation.
items.acceptance: No automatic upload; actual destination/security/consent/institutional authority must exist before synchronization is enabled.

items.title: Live HTTPS URL and deployable judge-facing page

items.acceptance: Public URL opens app; packs/install/offline readiness work at that origin; browser/device limitations and repo link are easy to find.

items.title: Charter/privacy/feasibility/evaluation and source package
items.remaining: README records build history, but planned charter/privacy/feasibility/evidence documents are incomplete or absent. Consolidate honest current specs without stale promises.
items.acceptance: Judges can find scope, device/language, model/license/size, retention/key policy, actual verification, gaps, replication and sources.

items.title: Required video, team photo, both submissions and release tag
items.remaining: Prepare the required challenge video/story and form assets; confirm current platform deadline/constraints directly before submission. Historic screenshot timing is not a current deadline check.
items.acceptance: Working repo/live links; required video and team photo; correct challenge; both platform and Google Form completed by user authorization; tag exact submitted release; no invented results.

items.title: Home/capture pack availability and explicit input language
items.remaining: Separate shell/model/dictation/text-pack/browser-reported local-voice statuses implemented. Actual hardware/offline voice verification remains tracked separately.
